text.title: Besieged Wall
text.body: Greystone Bastion guards the sole highland artery into the inner caldera. Stand beside Captain Rowan's garrison and repel three converging Iron Pact siege cohorts—scaling berserkers, cliffside rappellers, and iron-plated Stonebreaker war-golems—before the gatehouse falls.
text.obj.0: Hold Greystone Bastion and repel the three Iron Pact siege cohorts
text.msg.1: Three Iron Pact siege cohorts are closing on Greystone! Hold the parapet—if this artery breaks, the vanguard is cut off from Highcrest!
text.msg.2: The ladder berserkers break, yet flanking raiders are rappelling down the razor-cliffs into the courtyard!
text.msg.3: Stonebreakers! Colossal iron-plated war-golems are battering the timber gatehouse!
text.msg.4: Greystone's banners stand upright! The Iron Pact's field siege host is shattered against our walls!
text.win: Greystone Bastion holds unbroken and the Iron Pact's siege host scatters.
text.fail.1: Your hero fell on Greystone Bastion's battlements.
text.fail.2: Captain Rowan's garrison was overrun and Greystone Bastion fell.
